participant_roles: Factory Function=rolesRestrict; Dynamic Product Class=RolesRestriceGuard; Product Interface=CanActivate; Dependency=UsersService
intent_and_evidence: Parameterizes authorization guard generation by closing over allowed roles (...allowedRoles: string[]) to dynamically instantiate and register decorated CanActivate guard class instances via NestJS mixin(). Solves role duplication across GraphQL resolvers.

participant_roles: Batch Loader Provider=UserDataLoader; DataLoader Instance=userLoader; Target Repository=Repository<User>; Relational Resolver=BookingResolver.user
intent_and_evidence: Coalesces individual user ID lookups emitted during GraphQL field resolution ticks into a single SQL WHERE id IN (...) query via DataLoader. Solves GraphQL N+1 database query cascade when resolving booking user relations.

participant_roles: Batch Loader Provider=FlightDataLoader; DataLoader Instance=flightLoader; Target Repository=Repository<Flight>; Relational Resolver=BookingResolver.flight
intent_and_evidence: Collects flight ID fetch requests across request execution ticks and executes batch database queries via TypeORM In() operator. Eliminates N+1 relational database query overhead for flight field resolution.

participant_roles: Batch Loader Provider=SeatDataLoader; Single Loader Instance=seatLoader; Relation Loader Instance=seatManyLoader; Target Repository=Repository<Seat>; Relational Resolver=BookingResolver.seat
intent_and_evidence: Provides request-scoped batching infrastructure for seat entity retrieval and booking-seat relational mappings. Maps array of seat IDs and booking IDs to bulk SQL queries to prevent redundant database fetches.

participant_roles: Job Producers=SendGridService & UsersResolver; Queue Channel=BullMQ Queue 'email'; Consumer Worker=EmailProcessor
intent_and_evidence: Decouples synchronous API endpoint execution from asynchronous, IO-heavy email delivery operations. Enqueues job payloads (sending-token-sendGrid, sending-token-mailtrap) into Redis BullMQ queue consumed by background worker EmailProcessor.
